Quest USB/Link
Connecting your Quest to a VR-ready PC with a USB cable lets you use Virtual Desktop over USB on the newest Beta. When buying a cable, keep these things in mind:

Connector types
All Quest headsets use a USB-C port, so at least one end of your cable must be USB-C. The other end can be USB-A or USB-C; both perform the same.

USB standard
Get a USB 3.0 cable (also sold as USB 3.1 Gen 1 or USB 3.2 Gen 1x1). Avoid USB 2.0, as it will limit your bitrate.

Length
3-5m is ideal; USB cables shouldn't be much longer than that.

Battery
A cable extends playtime but won't necessarily charge faster than the headset drains. That's a limitation of many motherboards, not the cable.

Note: This will NOT change your max bitrate.
